scope: Read-only CPU source/design review. No pseudo-mask fit result or GPU evaluation was used to choose this review. Parent-lift design is reviewed; final implementation still needs verification.

fixed_contract.geometry: One complete18432-row M2 asset. Freeze centers, normals, sigma, thickness, opacity, pose, row order and renderer.
fixed_contract.optional_centre: Declare before inspecting RGB outcomes. It is secondary unless included in the primary list before fitting.
fixed_contract.H: Use only BUILD normalized operator column mass and object y+/y-/z+ weighted quartiles. State that this is normalized A mass, not raw alpha*T mass.
fixed_contract.training: Drop EVERY BUILD row with any structural nonzero in A[:,H]. Eliminate explicit stored zeros. No epsilon exception.
fixed_contract.test: Fixed original observed RGB rows with hidden contribution fraction>=0.9. Report other removed mixed rows separately.
fixed_contract.fit: One fresh2000-step SH0 common fit per case,6000 total. Rebuild median/c0 only from retained raw BUILD target.
fixed_contract.editable: Only exact zero columns of Atrain can change. Every nonzero-column colour remains frozen.
fixed_contract.real_full_branch: Separate branch may retain original full M2 supervised material and extend its10557 zero columns. It never provides pseudo-case answers, seeds or priors.

leakage_gates.requirement: All training target rows are BUILD40 raw-frame/pixel pairs. HELD9 contributes no RGB target, median, initialization, anchor or parameter selection.
leakage_gates.check: Persist row IDs and canonical content hashes.

leakage_gates.requirement: Atrain[:,H].nnz==0 across all BUILD frames; unknown[H].all() is true.
leakage_gates.check: Use exact CSR structural nonzeros after eliminate_zeros. Persist H and row-mask hashes.

leakage_gates.requirement: Forbidden RGB has no effect on training or completion.
leakage_gates.check: Poison all removed BUILD RGB and all HELD RGB. Row IDs, retained targets, median/c0, common-fit input/output and completion RGB content hashes must stay identical. Only evaluation scores may change. Hash canonical arrays, not ZIP timestamps.

leakage_gates.requirement: Artificial cases do not use old fitted M2 RGB, original prior, old colour flags or native predicted RGB as answers or seeds.
leakage_gates.check: Explicit field allowlist. Uniform0.5 geometry seeds are overwritten by fresh c0. Isolate the full-data branch loader.

leakage_gates.requirement: Extension receives only common_fit RGB at nonzero TRAIN columns and the fresh train median.
leakage_gates.check: Keep known_rgb[~unknown] input API. Unknown colours are absent from the extension interface. Rebuild all source support metadata after row removal.

leakage_gates.requirement: All methods share one common fit, one anchor set and the same allowed zero-column update domain.
leakage_gates.check: Byte-equal nonzero-column colours, identical common-fit hash. Count H, extra-zero outside H, natural-zero and graph-unreachable nodes separately.

leakage_gates.requirement: Graph/H/solver rules are frozen before fitting or reading validation RGB outcomes.
leakage_gates.check: Version contract with all five arms, graph parameters/hashes and fixed gates. No RGB-dependent adjacency or per-case best method.
Check Atrain@decoded_RGB after reload. Real full-data export preserves original canonical SH coefficients on nonzero columns bytewise and updates unknown DC only.

leakage_gates.requirement: One shared material table per method for all49 frames and both edits.
leakage_gates.check: No frame/edit-specific colours, no native-a6 renderer rows, identical full geometry and row order.

fairness.verdict: The strict mask/common-fit design is fair. Parent-lift arms are fair when registered before RGB outcomes and kept as separate discretization/adjacency controls.
fairness.NN_label: Current nearest is geodesic-nearest on the same graph, not Euclidean nearest. Compare estimator rules on that graph.
parent_conditions: Retain original child graph and both child arms; freeze all five arms before fitting.
Lift geometry edges to the same18432 fine vertices and use the same fine-row known colours as Dirichlet anchors.
Extra coarse colour averaging or refitting is an additional aggregation factor, so it cannot be called a pure adjacency control.
Check barriers at actual lifted endpoints. Parent-local h changes physical radii/tolerances even when formulas match; disclose the effective scale.
Every arm uses identical H>=0.9 test rows. Unreachable regions stay median and remain in the denominator.
fairness.connectivity_context: Parent reports1659 child components and1662 reachable original-zero columns before any pseudo-mask RGB fit. A disclosed geometry-only addition does not use validation RGB labels.
fairness.weak_anchors: Any nonzero TRAIN column may still be a weak regularized colour estimate. It is not a per-point measured colour label. Keep the declared seed rule fixed after results.

metrics.primary: RGB MAE on fixed H>=0.9 original observed rows, using normalized A@RGB versus original RGB[0,1]. One fixed denominator per RGB pixel.
record: Count/sum/mean per frame/case/method/split and paired differences against median.
Case-equal macro primary score. Within-case pooled pixel MAE, frame scores and worst-frame errors.
Mixed/boundary RGB error. Optional image-gradient error only on adjacent pairs inside the fixed test region.
All49 original full visible/reviewed a6 masks and fixed measured-depth denominators.
Factual keep-state a37/road/protected regions and strict reobserved-road delete references.
metrics.units: Keep normalized A colour metrics separate from premultiplied black-background render errors. Test masks are geometry-only and method-independent.
metrics.limits: Nearby frames/pixels are correlated. No pixel-iid significance claim. Original unknown lower surfaces have no hidden RGB truth.

proposed_fixed_gates.status: Engineering thresholds proposed before pseudo-mask RGB outcomes. Copy them into the versioned contract before fitting. These are not calibrated perceptual limits or sample-size power claims.

G0_integrity.pass_rule: All leakage gates pass. Geometry/provenance arrays bytewise frozen. Finite RGB[0,1], higher SH exactlyzero, one full asset in both edit states.
G0_integrity.failure: Invalid implementation until repaired/replayed with prior artifacts preserved.

G1_informativeness.action: Check with geometry/masks only. An insufficient case is inconclusive, never a pass. Report it without silent H/threshold retuning or omission.

G2_material_validation.primary: Case-equal HELD H>=0.9 MAE improves over fresh median by >=0.003 absolute AND >=10% relative.
G2_material_validation.case_guard: No mandatory case worsens by >0.003. At least ceil(2*K/3) of K mandatory cases improve by >=0.003.
G2_material_validation.claim: Supports withheld-colour continuation on this object/regions. It does not establish unseen semantic texture or true underbody colour.

G3_graph_specific_claim.pass_rule: For harmonic-vs-geodesic-nearest or parent-vs-child advantage, paired case-equal HELD MAE improves by >=0.002 and no mandatory case worsens by >0.003.
G3_graph_specific_claim.selection: Choose one global rule across regions and the real full-data case. Report all five arms. No regionwise validation-label winner assembly.

G4_frozen_render.rule: Any material-dependent geometry/alpha/depth/ownership change is an implementation failure.

G5_real_full_scene.BUILD_fit: A_BUILD@decoded_RGB exactly unchanged on all original27429 fit rows after reload.
G5_real_full_scene.a6_core: Pooled and each-frame original fixed a6-visible-core RGB MAE increase<=0.003 and mean RGB parent change<=0.003 versus original M2.
G5_real_full_scene.preservation: Pooled and each-frame mean RGB parent change<=0.003 on factual keep a37, original measured road and protected regions. Reference MAE increase<=0.003 where factual/reobserved RGB exists.
G5_real_full_scene.tails: Report p95/max/above0.02 counts and worst frames even when mean guards pass.
G5_real_full_scene.delete: Deleted-a37 pixels cannot use same-frame factual raw RGB as counterfactual truth. Newly revealed a6 material remains inferred.
G5_real_full_scene.acceptance: Engineering/preservation pass completes a valid comparison. Material quality needs G2; unknown-surface truth remains unavailable.

implementation_notes.examined: Base3-arm prepare/common-fit/child-extension code. Core row removal, fresh median, known-only API and common-fit sharing are correct.
implementation_notes.parent_updates: Parent will load target only from old inputs and preserve original frozen-row DC during real export. Final parent-lift implementation is not certified by this design review.
implementation_notes.poison_current: Existing prepare checks poisoned removed RGB leaves retained targets and median unchanged. Extend checks through common-fit/extension and HELD poisoning.

flowchart LR
 G[Fixed M2 geometry and A] --> H[Geometry-only spatial H]
 H --> D[Drop all H-contributing BUILD rows]
 R[Retained raw BUILD RGB] --> F[Fresh c0 and one common fit]
 D --> F
 F --> Z[Freeze nonzero TRAIN columns]
 Z --> M[Median]
 Z --> N[Geodesic nearest]
 Z --> P[Harmonic extension]
 M --> E[Same sealed H and HELD RGB evaluation]
 N --> E
 P --> E
 E --> S[49-frame keep/delete preservation]
